pages.lockedLine: Play the Frost Festival to read on

panels.line: Snow fell on the tower, and Pip did a happy loop. "The Frost Festival! Lanterns, cocoa and the great sled race!"
panels.alt: Pip, a small sleek owl, loops through falling snow over a winter village square strung with warm lanterns; Prince Arlo laughs below.

panels.line: But the lantern tree stood dark. Flurry the frost fox had tangled its lights in cursed arrows and growled at anyone near.
panels.alt: A tall pine in the village square, its lights wrapped in violet cursed arrows; Flurry, a frost fox wound in violet thorns, snarls at its foot.

panels.line: Arlo tested his bowstring. "Twenty tangles to the tree," said Pip, "and then a very grumpy fox. Ready?"
panels.alt: Prince Arlo, a knight archer with a golden longbow, grins at Pip perched on his shoulder, snowflakes on his silver armour.

pages.lockedLine: Free Flurry in the Frost Festival to read on

panels.line: With the last arrow, the thorns let go. Flurry sneezed, shook off the snow and wagged a very fluffy tail.
panels.alt: Flurry the frost fox, free of the thorns, sneezes a puff of snow and wags a huge fluffy tail while violet threads fall away.

panels.line: The lantern tree blazed with light, and the whole village cheered. Flurry won the sled race, sliding on his tummy.
panels.alt: The lantern tree glows gold over the cheering village; Flurry slides down a snowy hill on his tummy ahead of laughing sledders, Pip racing beside him.
